_label: Baselines v3 (19 Oct 2026). Sources are labelled per task: SRISHA = Srisha's estimate of his own manual time; ASSUMPTION = sourced or reasoned assumption, labelled; PLACEHOLDER = unverified, excluded from the headline 20x numbers.
_mopsHumanNote: mopsHumanMinutes = ASSUMED human time with @mops (typing/reviewing/approving). Machine time is measured separately from runs.

code.label: Campaign code
code.sourceNote: Srisha's estimate: 10 min for the campaign code alone
code.mopsHumanNote: assumed: glance at the generated code (fields come from the one intake)

code_sfdc.label: Campaign code + SFDC upload
code_sfdc.sourceNote: Srisha's estimate: 15 min. Time goes into mapping the event/ABM Excel to the SFDC upload template and finding the SFDC owner ID (SDR/AE)

budget.label: Budget request
budget.mopsHumanNote: assumed: 15s to review @mops's proactive quarterly draft (goal + warehouse ROI + calendar, with reasoning) and tap Approve or adjust

sow.label: SOW
sow.sourceNote: Srisha's estimate: 15-20 min, the most painful (many variables). Midpoint 17.5 used
sow.mopsHumanNote: assumed, realistic: 3–5 min (4 used) to answer one @mops question (venue if not booked, our PM, agency PM, agency confirmation), do a final review of every prefilled field with its source, and sign off. NOT zero-touch.

upload.label: List upload (event/ABM file)
upload.sourceNote: ASSUMPTION, varies by format. Conservative 60 min = low end of published ranges: 1-2 h per import incl. fix/re-import loops (Integrate case study), 2-4 h per 500-row tradeshow file (FoundryOps), ~3 h per messy CSV (Cotera), ~5 h per list (Mobly case study). Vendor sources, likely inflated, hence the low end
upload.mopsHumanNote: assumed: review low-confidence mappings + quarantined rows

report.label: Post-event report
report.sourceNote: ASSUMPTION: the report comes from the agency. Human time 30 min (chase, read, reformat). Elapsed wait 3 business days (72 h), an assumption, not measured

endToEnd.label: One event, intake → report (tasks Srisha estimated + labelled assumptions)
endToEnd.mopsIntakeNote: assumed: type or speak one @mops message with the shared fields
